native_names: Хорезмская Народная Советская Республика (Khorezmskaya Narodnaya Sovetskaya Respublika)

land.text: the khanate, whose Khan abdicated in February 1920

predecessors.note: Cliopatria draws the khanate at 384,764 km2 for 1918-19, six times the republic.

land.text: the Karakalpak lands, to the Karakalpak AO

successors.note: Karakalpak AO (no dossier); the page lists the AO among the infobox successors.

identity.name: Khorezm People's Soviet Republic

correction.text: borders with the Turkestan ASSR (north and south), the Bukharan PSR (east) and the Kirghiz ASSR (west) on KH; the page names no component

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe replacing Cliopatria's Khanate of Khiva 1918-19 shape (384,764 km2; the gazetteer reads it as about 338,000 km2). KH gives 62,200 km2 for the republic, ratio 0.16: the Cliopatria shape includes desert (Karakum, Kyzylkum, Ustyurt) the republic did not hold; the Khorezm and Tashauz admin-1s (about 69,000 km2) match the infobox.

ledger.note: 1920: the Khan of Khiva abdicates and the Khorezm republic is born. 'in February 1920, when the Khan abdicated in response to pressure'; infobox monarchy overthrown 2 February 1920; 'officially declared by the First Khorezm Kurultay (Assembly) on 26 April 1920'.

1923: the republic becomes the Khorezm Socialist Soviet Republic. 'On 20 October 1923, it was transformed into the Khorezm Socialist Soviet Republic.' Junaid Khan had briefly captured Khorezm in April 1922.

1924: the Khorezm SSR is divided. 'On 27 October 1924 the Khorezm SSR was divided between the' Uzbek and Turkmen SSRs and the Karakalpak AO; the party 'had to be strong-armed into voting for their own dissolution in July' (DEL).

wars.name: Junaid Khan's raids on Khorezm
wars.outcome: Junaid Khan 'briefly captured Khorezm in April 1922'; no lasting border change.
wars.note: Only the April 1922 capture is on the page.

certainty.note: The republic's borders with the Turkestan ASSR and the Bukharan PSR are described on KH but not surveyed; the desert margins are approximate.

sources.title: Khorezm People's Soviet Republic
sources.note: Created February 1920 (monarchy overthrown 2 February), declared 26 April 1920, 62,200 km2, Khorezm SSR 20 October 1923, divided 27 October 1924.

sources.title: National delimitation in the Soviet Union
sources.note: Partition decided April 1924; the Khorezm party strong-armed in July 1924.

notes: Written for batch ia-03-x from two pages (budget 1-2): KH and DEL. KH does not mention the 13 September 1920 treaty with Soviet Russia, the Amu Darya right bank or the Karakalpak lands as components; the region (Khorezm plus Tashauz) is the researcher's reading checked against the 62,200 km2 figure. Counterparts' dossiers: khanate-of-khiva (ia-03-b). The three successor entries point to the union dossier because the Uzbek SSR, Turkmen SSR and Karakalpak AO have none.
